C_s_reporting_boundary: The source log records aggregate measurement and unique-compile wall times, not a clean per-shape C_s,j breakdown; no retrospective per-shape allocation is claimed.
conclusion: A finite positive break-even exists only in the post-hoc i7 winning-shape scenario. The exact Transformer traces have negative denominators on i9 and K230, so no amount of reuse amortizes the generated path against the complete library.

cost_symbol_definitions.C_c: global calibration/model-fit wall time; observed as model_fit_wall_ms
cost_symbol_definitions.C_s_j: candidate generation, compilation, measurement and tuner cost attributable to shape j; current logs support only the aggregate sum over j
cost_symbol_definitions.C_s_total: observed calibration measurement wall time plus unique compile pipeline wall time

decision_rule: Search is worthwhile only when LCB95(V(H)) > 0.
deployment_cycle_definition: For the i7 post-hoc scenario, one deployment cycle is a synthetic equal-frequency portfolio unit with one call to each of the 19 selected shapes. It is not a model inference and not an observed deployment frequency distribution.
lcb95_break_even_definition: H_LCB = (C_c + sum_j C_s,j) / LCB95(sum_j f_j (t_b,j - t_o,j)); it is finite only when the denominator is strictly positive
legacy_metric_boundary: The legacy value is a future tuning-service workload horizon, not a matrix invocation count and not a model inference count.
posthoc_policy: The i7 winning set was selected after observing performance and is reported only as a descriptive upper bound. It is not evidence for a deployable pre-selection rule.
